Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL647319. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL647319, standard_relation = '=', and non-null standard_value and standard_relation. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
